name: Stausee Zillergründl
kurzbeschreibung: The fjord-like Speicher Zillergründl (1,850 m) in the Zillertal Alps features an imposing 186 m arch dam and the scenic trail to Little Tibet.
preis: Reservoir freely accessible; toll road from Bärenbad restricted to public buses and cyclists
oeffnungszeiten: Open daily from late May to mid-October (closed in winter)
beschreibung:
Overview

The picturesque high-altitude lake Speicher Zillergründl lies at an elevation of 1,850 meters, nestled deeply in the Zillertal Alps near the Italian border. The fjord-like reservoir extends for nearly five kilometers, dominated by the glaciated crests of the main alpine ridge, including the Reichenspitze and the Kuchelmooskopf. The technical showpiece of the facility is its colossal, 186-meter-high and 502-meter-long double-curved concrete arch dam wall, completed between 1980 and 1987 as one of the tallest dams in Austria. With a storage volume of roughly 89 million cubic meters, the reservoir generates eco-friendly hydroelectric energy for Verbund AG while offering an unspoiled, pristine alpine haven and popular excursion destination for mountain enthusiasts from all over the world.

Route & Requirements

Walking along the broad crest of the gigantic dam wall is level and barrier-free from the bus turnaround, providing breathtaking views down the sweeping concrete curve and into the turquoise waters. Along the eastern shoreline, a wide, gently ascending unpaved road leads into the high-alpine nature park towards the rustic Hohenaualm hut (approx. 1.5 hours walking time, 150 vertical meters, easy). The pasture is affectionately nicknamed 'Little Tibet of the Zillertal' due to its tranquil agricultural charm, grazing yaks, and colourful prayer flags. The trail is ideally suited for families and casual walkers, easily negotiated with all-terrain pushchairs. Sturdy walking shoes, sun protection, and a windbreaker are always recommended in this high-alpine setting. Sparkling mountain brooks accompany hikers along the way.

Visit & Arrival

Speicher Zillergründl is open daily during the snow-free summer months from late May to mid-October. Private vehicle traffic is strictly restricted and barred beyond Gasthof Bärenbad (approx. 14 km past Mayrhofen). Hourly public buses (line 4189) depart from Mayrhofen railway station, travelling via the toll road directly through the nature park to the dam wall. Alternatively, the route from Bärenbad to the dam is a highly popular challenge for e-bikers and cyclists.

Tips

Be sure to stop at the rustic Hohenaualm to savour homemade alpine cheese and fresh buttermilk while watching goats graze on the hillside pastures. The Bärenbad restaurant at the toll gate serves hearty Tyrolean fare for a rewarding meal before heading home as the afternoon sun illuminates the surrounding peaks.
saison: Juni bis Oktober (während der Wintermonate gesperrt)
